description: This file contains a utility function `shapeStackedSeries` that transforms raw cost records into a format suitable for visualization with stacking, such as in a chart. It processes an array of cost records, grouping and summing costs based on specified categories and services, with options for sorting and labeling.

methods.name: shapeStackedSeries(records, stackBy = "environment", options)
methods.description: Transforms raw cost records into a dataset suitable for stacked visualizations by categorizing and summing costs based on specified stack keys and options.
